Eligibility of Tenderer : As specified in the Tender Data Sheet (TDS), the Tenderer shall also meet the following requirements:-
The Tenderer shall have a minimum of eight (08) years of general experience in supplying software and ITES-related goods and
services, counted backward from the date of publication of the IFT in the e-GP System.
The Tenderer shall have completed within the last three (03) years: (a) at least one (01) software supply contract with a value not
less than BDT 70,00,000 (Seventy Lakh); and (b) at least one (01) ITES-related contract valued at not less than BDT 25,00,000
(Twenty-Five Lakh), including conference room/laboratory design, furniture, interior works, networking equipment, switches,
computers, printers, and related items.
The Tenderer shall have completed, as a Prime Contractor, at least one (01) similar ITES contract within the last three (03) years
with a value of not less than BDT 1,50,00,000 (One Crore Fifty Lakh) under any Government, Semi-Government, or Autonomous
Organization of Bangladesh.
The Tenderer shall submit a valid and updated Trade License, Certificate of Incorporation/Registration, TIN Certificate, VAT
Registration Certificate (BIN), and Income Tax Clearance Certificate with an acknowledgment slip.
The Tenderer shall submit audited financial statements for the last two (02) completed fiscal years and possess valid ABC and
Supervisory Licenses, where applicable.
The Tenderer shall submit at least one (01) NOA issued through the e-GP System demonstrating engagement in similar business
activities for a minimum of five (05) years and at least two (02) NOAs for ongoing contracts.
Joint Venture (JV) participation shall not be permitted.
Valid Manufacturer’s Authorization Certificates (MAF) from the respective OEMs for Desktop Computers and Drones must be
submitted.
